column7: Stage 7b: admits a keyed direct tools/call into the shared execution lease under the owner task admission spells; a refusal or a replay gives the 7a reservation back and spends no nonce (MIK-8154)

Delivers a 7a cache hit or a 7b replay through the direct route's own scan, shaping and signature; a 7b replay's 7a reservation is released before delivery (MIK-8154); a 7b replay to a caller stage 5 attached no per-caller credential for is refused as /mcp refuses it, after nonce admission so the nonce stays spent (MIK-8434)
Marks the lease dispatched just before the backend can be reached, so a later drop records an uncertain outcome instead of releasing the key (MIK-8154)
Withdraws the lease when the backend provably did not act, so the key is released instead of settled (MIK-8154)
